title: veggie.farm public garden data API
description: Versioned, project-owned JSON and GeoJSON compiled from cited public sources. Canonical parcels, site context, beds, and plants form the spatial core; browser plans are editable views over that core, not its source of truth.

standards.name: GeoJSON
standards.use: All collection item responses are RFC 7946 FeatureCollections; non-spatial records use null geometry.

standards.name: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12
standards.use: Schemas version and validate the maintained collection records.

standards.name: OGC API - Features
standards.use: Collection/item path layout and bbox, limit, offset, and ids query semantics. This static deployment uses an in-browser adapter and does not claim full HTTP conformance.

queryParameters.gardenId: project extension selecting canonical layer features for one garden identifier
queryParameters.property: exact property filters supplied as a key/value object to the client adapter
